purpose: Review every supplies/Herblore assignment with exact item role evidence, dose/serving effects, restrictions, and policy-limited typed cache identity. This version supplements, and never overwrites, the initial reviewer ledger.

direct_evidence.item_identity: Require the item ID in the pinned article index's exact infobox ID set; use only the `variants[itemId]` state and its suffix-specific params. A raw title, family hint, cache name, or another version's values cannot establish this ID's role.
direct_evidence.consumable_potion: Require direct exact-item evidence of a potion action/effect (Drink or Sip option plus potion facet or explicit potion prose; or an exact variant examine/effect that calls out potion use). Record the exact dose separately from its function.
direct_evidence.dose_state: Require an exact-ID version/examine/anchor that explicitly states N dose(s). Do not transfer counts between IDs, do not treat a general four-dose family as proof for another variant, and preserve dose as a state role alongside effect.
direct_evidence.food: Require exact-item Eat action or explicit eaten/edible statement plus a source-backed healing or other food effect. Capture HP/healing numbers when present. Category facets alone are insufficient.
direct_evidence.drink_energy: Require an exact Drink/Sip action and direct text or structured params for the item effect. Capture run-energy restoration separately from potion or food role.
direct_evidence.activity_and_restrictions: Require exact source text naming the activity or the exact-state restriction (for example, can only be used in an area). A potion's name, dose-family override, or incidental mention of an activity is insufficient.
direct_evidence.herblore: Require direct exact-item text that the item is used in Herblore, an exact unfinished-potion examine/stage, a Herblore secondary facet plus use evidence, or a clean/grimy state explicitly attached to the exact item variant. Keep secondary and output-stage roles distinct.
direct_evidence.quest_association: Record a quest association as a separate role when the exact item source explicitly provides it. Association never means quest-only or displaces a consumable role.
direct_evidence.unresolved: Retain unresolved when the exact item role, current taxonomy mapping, overlapping role priority, restriction, or exact state is not established. Name the missing fact.

allowed_inheritance.NOTE_VARIANT_OF: May inherit bank grouping from its exact `toItemId` only when the target has independently verified exact semantic evidence. Preserve a note-form role and do not infer usability, tradeability, acquisition, or other item properties. Apply the pinned Bank-page conversion policy only to bank storage grouping.
allowed_inheritance.PLACEHOLDER_FOR: May inherit grouping from its exact `toItemId` only when the target has independently verified semantic evidence and the current runtime placeholder mapping applies. Preserve placeholder state and zero-quantity slot semantics.
allowed_inheritance.BOUGHT_VARIANT_OF: No semantic or grouping inheritance. Review its own exact item-ID evidence.

typed_identity.evidence: Every inherited decision must include the exact typed cache edge, source/cache hashes and revision fields, directed numeric endpoints, plus separate exact Wiki evidence for the canonical target. A hash or edge alone establishes identity provenance, never role.

POTION.food: POTION/food is supported only by the exact item's food behavior; potions that also heal retain both roles and are unresolved if the primary destination cannot be chosen from the documented policy.
POTION.drink: POTION/drink requires an exact drink/sip role and source-backed effect.
POTION.potion: POTION/potion is for directly documented ordinary consumable potions; preserve dose and PvM/activity roles separately.
POTION.potion-dose-N: Use only when the current taxonomy deliberately assigns an exact numeric dose state to this subcategory. Dose does not identify the active ingredient/effect family.
POTION.activity-potion: Requires an exact documented activity association for the item state.
POTION.restricted-potion: Requires an exact documented use/area restriction for the item state.
POTION.pvm-utility: Requires an exact documented combat/PvM effect; this can coexist with potion or dose state.

HERBLORE.herblore: A direct exact-item Herblore material role supports the broad Herblore destination only when no more specific source-supported stage/ingredient role applies.
HERBLORE.secondary: Requires direct exact-item secondary ingredient use.
HERBLORE.unfinished-potion: Requires an exact unfinished-potion stage or examine.
HERBLORE.clean-herb/grimy-herb: State must be attached to this exact ID by a pinned variant record and corroborating direct item text.

food.predicate: Exact Eat behavior plus a directly documented food/healing effect establishes food as the primary use.

drink.predicate: Exact Drink/Sip behavior plus an item-specific beverage effect establishes drink as the primary use.

potion.predicate: Exact potion action/effect supports ordinary consumable-potion placement when no more specific supported state subcategory applies.

herblore-supply.predicate: The exact item-specific lead identifies a Herblore-created intermediate workflow item and the exact item options do not support direct eating or drinking.

unfinished-potion.predicate: The exact examine or item-specific lead identifies an unfinished potion awaiting another ingredient.

secondary.predicate: Direct item-specific source text identifies the item as a secondary ingredient for Herblore/potion production.

clean-herb.predicate: The exact item variant explicitly identifies a clean herb state and has a direct Herblore role.

grimy-herb.predicate: The exact item variant explicitly identifies a grimy herb state and has a direct Herblore role.
